I told Marcus in the #north-team thread that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 25 November.

That date comes only from Ilse's post in #north-team on 14 October. Marcus is a member of that channel, so he can see it himself. I read the channel from that post onward and nothing has changed the date since. Ilse's message is still the only source, since I found no Brackenwater contract to check it against. I mentioned that to Marcus in case the account sheet needs a source.

A renewal date is an operational fact for someone on the account's team, so no approval was needed.
